summary: Residential Rankin Street kerb with homes about 12 m away on its side.

best_section.where: South kerb of Rankin Street, in front of the red-roofed house midway along

drivers.seclusion: Detached home 12 m south at 28 m, others within 25 m all round; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with grass verge; cars park along both kerbs so a van fits in the lane.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm signed; cars parked along both kerbs, no sign of overnight campers.

flags: Steep: about 5% at best section, up to 12% along the stretch
Homes within 12 m on own side
sun_shade: Mostly open, with some street trees shading from the north side; large canopy at the west end.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to overnight vans
